observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 142.» (L14) in the left margin.

body L2, L3, L7, L11: specks stand over the n of «Lunae» (the first word of L2), over the u of «locus», over the u of «inaequalium» and over the first e of «praecessio»; they are not accents (the last two are about 1 pt long, a printed acute, as on the ǵ of p. 66, about 3.5 pt).

body L27: specks stand after «dinalis]» and before «maiorem»; they are not signs.
body L35, L39: the first o of «Anomalia» and the second o of «oppositionem» are printed thin, their sides as broken strokes.
notes_left L3: a speck stands low after «194,v.»; it is not a sign.
